question:
Choose the word that means the same as the given word.

Dandy
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'** i.e.** 'Beautiful'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word** "dandy"** refers to a man who is very concerned about his appearance and dresses in a stylish and fashionable way.
 
• **"Beautiful"** is an adjective used to describe something that is aesthetically pleasing, attractive, or visually appealing. (सुंदर)

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: **'Beautiful'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Cartel:** A cartel is an association of independent businesses or countries that come together to control the production, pricing, and distribution of a particular product or service. (कार्टेल)
 
• **Disappointment: **Disappointment refers to the feeling of sadness or dissatisfaction that arises when one's hopes, expectations, or desires are not fulfilled. (निराशा)
 
• **Dud:** A "dud" typically refers to something that does not work or perform as expected, particularly an object or device that fails to function properly.(नकारात्मक)
